lyrics.text: 狂岚卷起千重绯樱，弦音撕裂长夜寂静
lyrics.sub_text: Crimson gale sweeps the blossoms through the silent night

lyrics.text: 镜面映出疾驰残影，双翼共鸣直抵极星
lyrics.sub_text: Mirrored afterimages race in resonance toward the zenith star

lyrics.text: 在风暴之眼绽放吧，超越极限的终极回响
lyrics.sub_text: Bloom inside the eye of the storm, beyond the final overdrive

lyrics.text: 万瓣流光化作雷鸣，镌刻今夜不灭之名
lyrics.sub_text: Ten thousand luminous petals thunder into eternity
